name: Hotel Esencia
positioning: Independent beach hotel on a 50-acre estate on Xpu-Ha bay, between Tulum and Playa del Carmen, originally the private home of an Italian duchess
best_for: Couples wanting a secluded beach estate where the jungle meets the sea
Travelers who value a spa rooted in Mayan heritage
Families wanting a beach hotel with a separate children's pool

facts.text: The hotel was originally the private home of an Italian duchess.
Hotel Esencia is a 50-acre estate at the midpoint between Tulum and Playa del Carmen.
A new owner arrived in 2014, beginning a modern reimagining of the estate.
Owner and art collector Kevin Wendle added rooms and filled the renewed interiors with art and antiques.
The Main House is the hotel's centerpiece, with footpaths leading out to the suites and villas.
Guests are asked on arrival what morning drink they would like and when, and it is brought to them each day.
Spa treatments draw on local Mayan heritage and ingredients from the garden.
The pools are right by the beach and bordered by jungle.
The Beach Bar is wooden, lit by candlelight, right on the edge of the beach.
Guests can go snorkeling on the hotel's catamaran.
In 2026, for the third year in a row, Hotel Esencia was awarded Three Michelin Keys by the Michelin Guide.

highlights.text: Each year sea turtles make their nests in the bay of Xpu-Ha.
The hotel sits where the Yucatan jungle meets the sands of Xpu-Ha bay, one of the remaining undeveloped shores of the Mayan Riviera.
The spa has several hot tubs set in niches under a thatched palapa.
Accommodation includes Jungle Suites with a plunge pool.

considerations.text: The hotel is 30 minutes from Tulum, on an estate midway between Tulum and Playa del Carmen.
There are two pools of equal size, one for children and one for adults.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions.
